# Apple Bud

Apple Bud is the tiny pale-yellow earth-pony foal with bright green hair and black eyes seen in an old Apple family photograph in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Think of Apple Fritter's color palette on a baby pony.

[![Apple Bud — Friendship Is Magic, Hasbro/DHX Media, S3E8 screenshot](https://img4.wikia.nocookie.net/__cb20130707200206/mlp/images/4/47/Apple_Bud_closeup_ID_S3E8.png)](https://www.bronies.de/showthread.php?pid=3672631#pid3672631)

- **Name:** A fandom identification documented by February 2014; the original coiner and any official naming remain unverified.
- **Gender and family:** An Apple family foal; exact parentage and gender are unconfirmed. The catalog's filly classification is not established by the show.
- **Speaking status:** No known dialogue or credited voice actor.
- **Appearances:** The [foal directory](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals) also reports the design on wave 13 mystery-pack box artwork and a postcard. No additional narrative appearances verified.

## Important moments

- **The family album —** [Apple Family Reunion (S3E8)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Apple_Family_Reunion). While the Apples revisit memories of earlier reunions, Apple Bud appears in an archival family photograph. This is the only documented story scene; the foal is not identified among the attendees at the current reunion. A video timestamp could not be independently verified.

The screenshot's source post is verified, but the legacy image host and direct wiki fetches returned access errors; the wiki details were available through indexed excerpts. No second defining scene or independently verified fan artwork was found.
